name: tracker-adapter-polling
goal: Prove Tracker 122e190 adapter polling over an injected exclusive lease, including restart, retry, watermark and atomic journal receipts with synthetic GitHub data.

evidence: Preserve adapter_runner, adapter_sources, adapter_links and adapter_events compatibility. Assert lease contention and release, poll-start cursor and overlap, retries after atomic rollback, close/reopen mapping, and pending write-back until confirmed.

Reused #150 for issue scope and planning and #144 for the appendLocal transaction. Added existing adapter-table compatibility, injected exclusive lease and provider seams, event mapping and durable tracked-label write-back.

MB2 one-worker Vitest: unchanged assertions went red in all 7 cases at f5421a26e32, then passed 7/7 at 6b1bc4cbed. Cases cover SQLite lease denial/cancellation, restart and overlapping cursor, op+receipt rollback, status mapping and provider retry.
